summary: Release run 40628012072's release journeys failed on Windows with only "timeout waiting for '[data-testid=\"space-end\"]' to be actionable" and "Choosing an empty cell did not move the selected endpoint", and kept no evidence, so the cause could not be read. A tap that never becomes actionable now reports whether the element kept moving and what its centre hits, and the Numberlink check reports the labels it read.
